name: io.github.andresolbach/nodriver-mcp-server
title: nodriver — undetected browser automation
description: Undetected, anti-bot-resistant Chrome automation. 57 tools. Stealth chrome-devtools-mcp alternative.

environmentVariables.name: NODRIVER_USER_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Explicit persistent Chrome profile directory. Default: an ephemeral temp profile, auto-deleted per session.

environmentVariables.name: NODRIVER_BROWSER_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Chrome/Chromium executable. Auto-detected when unset.

environmentVariables.name: NODRIVER_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Proxy server address passed to Chrome as --proxy-server.
